defects.title: Import error loses entered data and mapping
defects.observe: After the temporary import error, the app returns to Upload contacts and the pasted CSV and column mapping are gone.

defects.title: Import allows duplicate jobs from a double click
defects.observe: A rapid double click creates two jobs and the result says 22 contacts imported instead of 11.

defects.title: Completion status appears while the import is processing
defects.observe: The page says Import complete immediately after accepting the job, while the job is still processing.

defects.title: Import action is clipped at tablet widths
defects.observe: At a viewport from 768 to 1024 pixels wide, the mapping container clips the Import button so it cannot be reached.

defects.title: Discard dialog does not manage focus or keyboard
defects.observe: Cancel import opens a plain div, not a modal dialog: focus stays on the page behind it, Tab reaches page controls behind it, Escape does not close it, and focus is not returned when it closes.

defects.title: Team select has no accessible name
defects.observe: The Team select shows the text Team beside it, but the text is not a label, so assistive technology announces the select without a name.

known_issues_all_variants.observe: The preview shows CSV columns in file order and ignores the chosen mapping, so a wrong mapping imports wrong data without warning.
At 390x844 the import error appears at the top of the page, above the visible area, while the user is at the Import button.
Keyboard focus returns to the start of the page after Continue and Import.
The result step has no way to start over.

note: Known issues were found by ux-audit runs on 2026-10-08 and confirmed by reading the code. They are not planted defects: graders must not count them as false positives.
